maddeler.e:
نتغافل (form VI)
# نَتَغَافَلُ (nataḡāfalu) /na.ta.ɣaː.fa.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَغَافَلَ (taḡāfala)
# نُتَغَافَلُ (nutaḡāfalu) /nu.ta.ɣaː.fa.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of تَغَافَلَ (taḡāfala)
# نَتَغَافَلَ (nataḡāfala) /na.ta.ɣaː.fa.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَغَافَلَ (taḡāfala)
# نُتَغَافَلَ (nutaḡāfala) /nu
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
